gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC squeezes its letters close and lets the lowercase tower over its own capitals, while Metamorphous looms above with wide sidebearings. Long paragraphs feel dense but brisk.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its rounded sans-serif forms into a dense huddle, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Metamorphous, by contrast, does its best work with a high midline and gentle stroke modulation, while Anaheim just keeps things moving.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads close-knit, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Metamorphous adds a commanding top layer with generous sidebearings and a high midline, and the tight plain sans text underneath gives those spacious headings something compact to rest against.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-arsenal-sc: Contemporary and tightly fitted, Arsenal SC holds the line. Metamorphous earns attention with its high midline and soft fat-to-slim strokes, while the sans-serif below offers only a faint thick-thin shift and wide, open mouths.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-asimovian: Metamorphous carries a quiet shift in line weight, like brushed watercolor. Asimovian sits below it as a sans with tall lowercase bodies and one stroke width, so the ornate heading and the plain text stay clearly apart.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-basic: Basic reads clean and businesslike, with just a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals and little stroke contrast. Metamorphous does the showy work with its middling contrast and big sidebearings; Basic simply stays out of the way.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-cal-sans: Metamorphous opens with wide sidebearings, a high midline and modest thick-thin contrast that feels distinctive. Cal Sans follows in a single stroke width, plain as stitched thread, with short ascenders and a tall x-height to ground it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-carlito: Metamorphous holds the top with generous sidebearings, a high midline and the mild thick-thin variation of a letterpress slug. Shrink it, though, and Carlito's tight, spool-wound sans-serif text would start to outshout it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-changa: Changa gives its lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals, which makes the sans text feel modern and sturdy. And Metamorphous above it, with its light stroke variation, stays gracious while a full page of Changa plows ahead.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-courier-prime: Metamorphous stands out for its roomy sidebearings, high midline and sturdy thin lines paired with slightly heavier thick ones. Courier Prime, a monospace, plays it plain beneath, in marker-drawn characters. Big, short lines are where the heading earns its keep.
